title: Exploring Oversmoothing with Householder Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2608.12514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep graph neural networks(GNNs) suffer from oversmoothing- a progressive collapse of node representation towards a low information subspace as network depth increases because the normalized graph propagation operator is repeatedly applied directly to the hidden representations. In this work we study Householder Graph Neural Network (HouseGNN). Rather than updating the hidden state like standard GCN, HouseGNN uses the aggregated neighbourhood message solely to estimate a reflection direction; the node embedding is then updated by a Householder reflector followed by GroupSort, yielding a piecewise orthogonal layer that preserves Euclidean norm at every node and at every depth. We prove three core properties: (i) every internal layer preserves the node-wise Euclidean norm; (ii) the Householder reflector is scale scale and sign-invariant in the message; and (iii) pairwise distance between nodes can change through mismatch between node-wise

translated_title: 探索利用Householder矩阵解决过度平滑问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12514v1 公告类型：新 摘要：深层图神经网络（GNNs）面临过度平滑问题——随着网络深度增加，由于归一化图传播算子被反复直接应用于隐藏表示，节点表示会逐渐坍缩到低信息子空间。在本研究中，我们研究了Householder图神经网络（HouseGNN）。与标准GCN更新隐藏状态不同，HouseGNN仅利用聚合的邻居消息来估计反射方向；然后通过Householder反射器结合GroupSort更新节点嵌入，产生一个分段正交层，该层在每个节点和每个深度都保持欧几里得范数。我们证明了三个核心性质：（i）每个内部层保持节点级欧几里得范数；（ii）Householder反射器在消息中具有尺度不变性和符号不变性；（iii）节点间的成对距离可以通过节点级不匹配而改变。
tldr: 本文提出HouseGNN，利用Householder反射器实现分段正交层，有效缓解深层GNN的过度平滑问题，并保持节点范数不变。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HouseGNN, which uses Householder reflectors to create piecewise orthogonal layers, effectively mitigating oversmoothing in deep GNNs while preserving node norms.
